notes.lead: The one deck they can do alone
notes.body: Hard or soft? needs no sound and marks itself, so it is the only deck in this unit a child can work through without you sitting there. Leave them to it.

cards.f: When is c hard, and when is it soft?
cards.m: Hard before a, o, u â casa, cosa, cura. Soft, like ch in chair, before e and i â cena, cinema.

cards.f: When is g hard, and when is it soft?
cards.m: Hard before a, o, u â gatto, gonna, gusto. Soft, like j in jam, before e and i â gelato, giro.

cards.f: What does an h do after c or g?
cards.m: Forces the hard sound back: chi, che, spaghetti, ghiaccio. The h itself is never pronounced.

cards.f: What does an i do after c or g, before a, o or u?
cards.m: Forces the soft sound: ciao, giornale. That i is not pronounced as a separate sound.
